purpose: Teach: スクエア/ギャル/ゲノム/クリスタル/修道/ウルトラ/ミャンマー/ヒゲ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんのお店、スクエアテーブルがお気に入りなの
lines.en: Sho, you really love that square table at my shop, don't you?
lines.style: Warm, noticing tone. Soft open on his name. Gentle observation, like she's delighted by the detail. Stable, unhurried pace.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ギャルのお姉さん、優しかったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, that beautiful lady at your shop was so kind to me.
lines.style: Earnest, direct delivery. Small voice but genuine. Open wonder about the kindness he witnessed. No affectation, just truthfulness.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがゲノムの絵本、見せてくれるって
lines.en: Sho, your dad said he'd show you that book about genomes.
lines.style: Warm, conspiratorial. Slight lift on the news—delighted to share something she knows will excite him. Soft, maternal pacing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、クリスタルのおもちゃ、きれいって思う
lines.en: Mei-sis, I think those crystal toys are really pretty.
lines.style: Soft certainty. Small enthusiast voice. He's sharing something he discovered, not asking permission. Gentle conviction.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、修道院の鐘の音、優しい音色ね
lines.en: Sho, the sound of the monastery bells is so lovely, isn't it?
lines.style: Hushed, almost reverent. She's inviting him into noticing something delicate with her. Slow, peaceful pace. Breathes in the beauty.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、ウルトラヒーロー好きだよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I really like Ultra Heroes!
lines.style: Bright, unguarded enthusiasm. Quick tempo on the declaration. The joy of sharing something he loves without holding back.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが、ミャンマーの絵本、お土産でくださったわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad brought back a picture book from Myanmar as a souvenir.
lines.style: Warm delivery, slight anticipation. She's sharing news gently, like opening a small gift. Relaxed, unhurried rhythm.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、お父さんのヒゲ、最近長くなったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad's beard has gotten longer lately.
lines.style: Observant, amused noticing. Small, matter-of-fact tone—just a detail he's registered and sharing. Quiet warmth underneath.
